creator_id.description: Only pull requests by this user ID.

pull_requests.description: Show the project's active pull requests, everyone's unless reviewer_id or creator_id is set. Default true.

reviewer_id.description: Only pull requests with this reviewer (a user or team ID).

token_command.description: A command that prints the token, e.g. [op, read, "op://dev/azure/pat"]. Used instead of token_env.

token_env.description: Variable holding a personal access token (Work Items and Code, read). Default AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT.

url.description: Default https://dev.azure.com. For Azure DevOps Server, the collection's server URL.

work_items.description: A WIQL query for the work items. Default: open items assigned to you (@Me) in the project, recently changed first. null leaves them out.

entries.description: Azure DevOps work items (from a WIQL query, default: open items assigned to you) and active pull requests for one project (all of them, unless reviewer_id or creator_id narrows the list). Priority 1 items, rejected and conflicting pull requests show red, priority 2 and "waiting for author" yellow, approved green. Click one to open it. Untested live: built from the API docs and sample responses.
